name: @cupper/desktop
description: The Electron app: main process, preload and the renderer entry.

scripts.build:dev: cargo build --locked --release -p cupper-desktop-native --features dev-auth --target-dir ../../target/host-bundle/build && cargo xtask host-bundle --kind dev && vite build --mode dev && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.build:e2e: cargo build --locked --release -p cupper-desktop-native --features dev-auth --target-dir ../../target/host-bundle/build && cargo xtask host-bundle --kind e2e && vite build --mode e2e && electron-builder --config electron-builder.e2e.yml
scripts.test:launch: cargo build --locked -p cupper-desktop-native --features dev-auth && cargo xtask host-bundle --kind e2e --debug && CUPPER_HOST_BUNDLE=../../target/host-bundle/e2e vitest run src/main/host/launch.test.ts
